en.headline: Hong Kong Disneyland Hotel to close from 12 October for major renovation
en.dek: The Victorian-style hotel, open since 2005, will undergo comprehensive upgrades including more Disney movie-themed rooms; the other two resort hotels remain open.
body: Hong Kong Disneyland announced on Friday that its original Disneyland Hotel will temporarily close from 12 October 2026 for a full renovation and upgrade. No reopening date has been set.

Anita Lai, vice-president of communications and public affairs, said the property would retain its classic charm while adding more immersive storytelling experiences and Disney movie-themed rooms. Renovation work on the west wing has already been under way since June.

The hotel has 400 rooms. Disney Explorers Lodge and Disney’s Hollywood Hotel, with 750 and 600 rooms respectively, will continue operating. Lai said average occupancy across the three hotels exceeded 80 per cent during the recent summer holiday.

zh.headline: 香港迪士尼樂園酒店10月12日起暫時關閉翻新
zh.dek: 開業以來的維多利亞式酒店將進行全面升級，增加迪士尼電影主題房間；另外兩間度假酒店維持開放。
body: 香港迪士尼樂園周五宣布，香港迪士尼樂園酒店將由2026年10月12日起暫時關閉，進行全面翻新及升級工程，重開日期尚未公布。
傳訊及公共事務副總裁黎珮珊表示，酒店會保留經典魅力，同時融入更多沉浸式故事體驗及迪士尼電影主題房間。西翼工程已於6月展開。
酒店提供400間客房。迪士尼探索家度假酒店及迪士尼好萊塢酒店分別有750及600間客房，將繼續營業。黎珮珊指剛過去的暑假三間酒店平均入住率超過八成。
